home.title: Learn in a safe place, and prove what you learned
home.lead: Web development, cybersecurity and KVKK compliance training with animated lessons, quizzes and verifiable certificates.

learn.title: Interactive lessons
learn.body: Learn step by step with video, animated modules and in-browser exercises.

prove.title: Verifiable certificates
prove.body: Every certificate is digitally signed and anyone can verify it by its certificate number.

comply.title: Compliance for teams
comply.body: Assign training to employees, follow their progress and report on KVKK compliance.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for may have moved or never existed.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is wrong, or the account is temporarily locked. After several failed attempts the account locks for 15 minutes.
errors.email_not_verified: Verify your email address before signing in. Check your inbox.
errors.disposable_email: Temporary email addresses are not accepted. Use a permanent address.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalid_code: The code is not valid. Enter the current code from your app.
errors.challenge_expired: The verification step timed out. Sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session could not be confirmed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.mfa_required: Turn on two-factor authentication to enter the admin area.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.
errors.invalid_input: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.totpLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lead: Start learning on your own or train your team.
signUp.personalHint: I want to learn for myself.
signUp.companyHint: I want to assign training to my employees and follow their progress.
signUp.name: Full name
signUp.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A long sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
signUp.companyNote: Whoever opens a company account becomes its admin and must turn on two-factor authentication.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. The link is valid for 24 hours.
checkEmail.note: If it does not arrive, look in your spam folder.

account.title: My account
account.setupStep1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
account.manual: If you cannot scan it, enter this key by hand:
account.setupStep2: Enter the 6-digit code your app shows.
account.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Your sessions on other devices were signed out.
account.sessionsLead: Sign out any session you do not recognise straight away.

admin.title: Organization admin
admin.name: Name
admin.auditLead: The last 100 critical actions in your organization. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.
